verifyEmail.notVerified: Email not yet verified. Please check your inbox and try again.

verifyEmail.resent: Verification email sent! Check your inbox.
verifyEmail.signOutOther: Sign out and use a different account

username.title: Pick a username
username.intro: This is the name other people see on your annotations and in the organizations you join.
username.label: Username
username.saveFailed: Could not save that username. Please try another.
username.rules: Letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens - 3 to 30 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
username.tooShort: Username must be at least {{min}} characters
username.tooLong: Username must be at most {{max}} characters

sdk.invalidBody: This page authorizes the STACNotator Python SDK and can only hand credentials to a local process on your own machine. Start the login from Python with stacnotator.login(url).
sdk.title: Authorize the STACNotator SDK
sdk.body: A process on your machine (port {{port}}) is asking to act as your account. Authorizing hands it a login token so scripts can read campaign labels and register prediction layers without a password.
sdk.onlyContinue: Only continue if you just ran stacnotator.login(...) yourself.
sdk.sessionFailed: Could not read your current session. Please reload and try again.
